blocks.text: A layout component can provide the outer page structure. A slot marks where a page puts its own content.
Use an Astro project. Save examples at the shown src paths. Astro files are built into HTML and need the Astro tool; they do not run as plain HTML in this playground.

blocks.title: Wrap content with a layout

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: A slot marks where caller-supplied content is displayed. Text inside a slot is fallback content when that slot is empty.
`Astro.props` holds values supplied to an Astro component or generated route at render time.

blocks.text: A page that imports Base and wraps its content in <Base> gets the shared document structure.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Leave a slot for the page content. A layout without one hides its children.
